Exam marking is an education-sector use, recorded under the sectoral study.

facts.fact: Education minister Raissa Malu told the Council of Ministers on 15 August 2025 that an AI system automated exam-paper marking in 2025, with results published three days after the exams.
Minister Malu reported AI exam processing cut processing time by 30-40 percent, raised speed tenfold, and lifted scanning from 8-10 to 80-100 papers a minute.

COD.note: No local AI development or computing stated.
